name: spatial_alignment_runner_plugin
description: Runner adapters for hosted LLM code generation and local coding-agent execution on spatial-alignment benchmark tasks.

runners.description: Calls the OpenAI Responses API, asks the model to write a Python solver, executes that solver locally, then runs the deterministic scorer.
Runs a locally authenticated Codex CLI agent inside the prepared workspace and scores its submitted coordinate CSVs.
runners.dry_run_command: uv run python scripts/run_local_coding_agent.py {task} --agent codex --model gpt-5.3-codex --dry-run --force
runners.run_command: uv run python scripts/run_local_coding_agent.py {task} --agent codex --model gpt-5.3-codex --reasoning-effort xhigh --force

runners.description: Runs a locally authenticated Claude Code CLI agent inside the prepared workspace and scores its submitted coordinate CSVs.
runners.dry_run_command: uv run python scripts/run_local_coding_agent.py {task} --agent claude --model claude-sonnet-4-6 --dry-run --force
runners.run_command: uv run python scripts/run_local_coding_agent.py {task} --agent claude --model claude-sonnet-4-6 --force

runners.description: Runs the mini-SWE-agent CLI against the prepared workspace and scores its submitted coordinate CSVs.
runners.dry_run_command: uv run python scripts/run_local_coding_agent.py {task} --agent mini-swe --model gpt-5-mini --dry-run --force
runners.run_command: uv run python scripts/run_local_coding_agent.py {task} --agent mini-swe --model gpt-5-mini --dangerous-bypass --force

runners.description: Calls an Azure OpenAI Responses deployment, executes the generated solver locally, then runs the deterministic scorer.
runners.dry_run_command: uv run python scripts/run_openai_solver.py {task} --provider azure --model gpt-6-astra --dry-run --force
runners.run_command: uv run python scripts/run_openai_solver.py {task} --provider azure --model gpt-6-astra --force

result_artifacts: request_payload.json for hosted OpenAI code generation
solver_from_openai.py when using hosted code generation
